name: contract-game-generated-types

The existing app CLI case also generates an API whose SvelteKit import masks missing ambient declarations. Preserve the four game combinations; strengthen the existing app-plan case with a framework type-reference assertion and retain normal compiler execution.

Product-only a1dd559fbc emits src/app.d.ts with the framework ambient type reference for every generated app/game. Standalone routes resolve virtual modules without incidental API imports; frozen cases are unchanged.

Matched laptop green 3d6924ccbe4a passes the identical ten-case command after red e16f1da1a990. All four game combinations compile, reject missing baselines, build, audit and retain gameplay/invalid-document assertions.
